name: TATA Health International Holdings Limited
summary: TATA Health International Holdings Limited, founded in 1974 and based in Kwai Chung, is an investment holding company that was named S. Culture International Holdings Limited until November 2020. It trades footwear and healthcare products and runs financial and online medical services, with a presence in Hong Kong, Australia, Macau and the mainland. It wholesales and retails brands including Clarks and Josef Seibel through its own stores.
